d: While struggling to survive, Manny and Kizie, who each have a terminal illness, fall in love with each other. Thereafter, the two try to spend the rest of their days being happy and staying positive.
Manu, an NRI doctor, comes to India in search of a bride and falls in love with Tanu. Poles apart from her suitor, Tanu, a fun-loving girl, rather enlists his help in eloping with her lover.
Mohan, a successful scientist from America, travels back to India in search of his childhood nanny, Kaveri Amma. However, his life takes a turn when he begins to rediscover his roots.
